scope: classified Square product-payment webhook recovery only

nodes.audit: Production supplies product, refund and invoice adapters independently; other dispatch remains unqualified.
Bounded raw signature dispatch, SELECT-only classification, product-only effect boundary; product conflicts retain uncertainty.
Completed product recovery awaits finalizer and notification handoff. Retryable failures produce 503; noncompleted payments skip business effects.
Locked money/order transaction, idempotent payment ledger, stock/shipment activation or late-capture refund reservation; all awaited.
Selected commit routine awaits movement insert and inventory update; no-row update marks uncertainty. Other exports are not qualified.
Selected activation routine performs locked SELECT/UPDATE and verifies resulting state; no provider call or worker start.
Selected reservation routine checks components and persists deterministic adjustment/refund keys in the existing transaction. Worker/provider settlement is separate.
Selected ForOrder routine awaits atomic claim/outbox (or legacy fallback); null claims/false fallback inserts mark uncertainty. Actual email-sending exports are not invoked.
Selected order lookup is SELECT-only; atomic paid-product claim/outbox awaited. False enqueue marks uncertainty; null claim handled by notification service.
Selected enqueue validates linked product order/deadline, encrypts payload and inserts durable outbox; no worker execution. Conflict returns false, retained as uncertainty by caller.
Raw signature verification and parsing precede effects.
Body byte limit before HMAC work.
Actual source/producer/target/login/TLS and current epoch checks; durable operation begin/finish.
Operation-local uncertainty survives success-shaped results; inert outside context.
Nonstreaming adapter awaits business work and treats 5xx as uncertain; sanitized retryable admission errors.
Existing shared business pool; no parallel data layer.
Selected encryption routine uses local authenticated crypto and configured key; no external retrieval or detached task.

excluded: independent outbox/refund/shipment workers and provider settlement
actual deployment/provider fencing, owned bootstrap, parent release/recovery coordinator
limits: Controlled ledger/business terminals in route tests; separate actual PostgreSQL business regressions and inherited protocol tests.
